About this service

This service might be right for you if:

  • You need to determine whether probate is necessary.
  • You have responsibilities as a Personal Representative.
  • You are responsible for administering a trust.
  • You need help with fiduciary records or accountings.

What we cover

What probate & trusts includes

Estate administration
Identify assets, address obligations and distribute estate property.
Personal Representatives
Understand estate duties, required filings and records.
Trust administration
Review trust documents and support trustee responsibilities.
Fiduciary accountings
Organise financial activity and prepare or review accountings.
